description: This file implements a PlacesService module for searching and retrieving details of various places using different external providers like Nominatim, Google, and Mapbox, with a local fallback dataset. It exports a singleton object with public methods search and details to interact with place data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Search places based on a query using configured provider or fallback dataset, returning the top results.

methods.name: details
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific placeId, either from local data or via a search.
